lines: All that power and this is what you use it for?
This petty joke of a machine was probably made by those villagers, who can't even distinguish their own noses from a rock.
I'm disappointed. A single nether star can power a whole city and you use it for... a tiny buff?
and this beam... instead of focusing the light, this beacon blocks it. only letting a fraction through.
Truly a slap on the face of Armai - who invented it
